purpose: Qualify physical VBUS indication, charge revocation and data integrity; Q3 is presence detection, not a precision voltage supervisor
preconditions: Exact Q3 MPN and installed resistor parts recorded
Current-limited USB source plus battery emulator first; real cell only after separate charge-guard qualification
Document source slew, cable impedance, instrument loading and bandwidth
Record PCB and firmware hashes and active USB power configuration

cases.stimulus: Remove 5 V while configured and charging requested; repeat while reading storage
Ramp 5 V to 0 V and back; record actual Q3 gate and PA0 transition voltages
Sweep interruption durations across measured detector and application response times
Detach during suspend/resume pulse and during 10 ms charge settling interval
Reset MCU during attached, suspended and detached states
Detach during export with battery emulator near configured low-battery cutoff

measurements: Time from physical VBUS change to PA0 transition
Time from PA0 transition to charge-request LOW and CE inhibit
Time from charge request revoke to actual charging current cessation
Minimum V3V3 during transition and reset/brownout status
Authenticated exported chunk sequence before and after interruption
acceptance: No charge request while observed VBUS is absent; do not infer actual current cessation from GPIO alone
No fresh high-current grant until new session has acknowledged configuration
CE levels satisfy charge-enable-limits.json wherever the charger is in its specified operating domain
No invalid committed recording accepted by host; interrupted data handled by existing recovery policy
Record all transition latencies; no numerical worst-case timing claim until measured coverage and power hold-up requirement are established
open_qualification: Detector threshold/temperature/hysteresis not guaranteed by 2.5 V RDS test point
Polling and synchronous storage can delay application response; source inspection alone does not bound end-to-end latency
Short VBUS bounce with stale USB session requires system-level test; policy unit test covers sustained observed absence

software_evidence.new_test_scope: 500mA variants: observed detach while mounted/ACK remain stale, stale resume rejected, repeated absence stays revoked, new session does not grant before ACK
software_evidence.instrumentation: Host ASan/UBSan and mocked driver; no physical timing or current evidence
